title: Rigorous integration of semilinear parabolic PDEs: forward evolution bounds and projected boundary value problems
summary: In this work, we present a rigorous integrator for initial and boundary value problems for semilinear parabolic PDEs. The method builds on earlier semigroup-based approaches while improving the bounds used in the fixed-point argument and extending the class of problems that can be treated. In particular, it controls the solution operator without requiring backward integration of the variational equation and allows projected boundary value problems to be studied through a simplified construction of an approximate inverse for the linearized operator.
